description: This Java source file defines the Development class, which extends LauncherActivity. It customizes the target intent for a launcher and modifies the list of resolved activities to include the developer settings with the highest priority.

classes.name: Development
classes.description: A launcher activity that sets up a custom target intent and modifies the result list to prioritize the developer settings activity.

methods.name: getTargetIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns an Intent with ACTION_MAIN and CATEGORY_TEST to specify the target startup activity.

methods.name: onSortResultList
methods.description: Overrides the method to insert the highest priority developer settings activity into the list of ResolveInfo results if available.
